# Overview

This repository hosts the reproducible data ingestion, standardization, and quality control pipelines used to integrate diverse soil spectral libraries into the Open Soil Spectral Library (OSSL) in standardized Level 0 format (Level 1 currently under revision).

You can find more information about the prepared soil spectral libraries in the [**Listed Libraries** section](https://docs.soilspectroscopy.org/libraries.html) in the [**Manual**](https://docs.soilspectroscopy.org/), or interactively at the [**OSSL Chemometrics** tool](https://soilspectroscopy.github.io/ossl-chemometrics/).

# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the OSSL data import pipelines!

To get started with contributing datasets, pipelines, or updates:

- Check the contribution guide in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).  
- Use the provided dataset template in [dataset/_template](dataset/_template).
